title: Kimi delegation plan
description: YAML frontmatter contract that /kimi:code and /kimi:review consume.

id.description: Slug used for job-id, branch name, and worktree dir. Lowercase, digits, hyphens. Max 64 chars.

goal.description: One- to few-sentence statement of what 'done' means.

base_branch.description: Branch the worktree is created from.

files_may_touch.description: Glob whitelist. Reviewer flags any change outside this set.

out_of_scope.description: Things explicitly NOT to do. Empty array allowed but field required.

success_criteria.description: Verifiable conditions. Reviewer uses these as the rubric.
